On May 26, 2026 the Griffin Board of Commissioners voted unanimously to approve amendments to the Unified Development Code (UDC) establishing special-use-permit regulation of data centers in Planned Industrial Districts (PID). Minor facilities (up to 10,000 sq ft) and major facilities (10,000-275,000 sq ft) are allowed with setback/buffer/noise/water-use and decommissioning-bond conditions; hyperscale/campus data centers (500,000+ sq ft) are prohibited. This permanent ordinance superseded the Jan. 13, 2026 moratorium ahead of its scheduled July 12, 2026 expiration.
